description: This file contains benchmarking code for CrewAI, measuring tool registration, memory footprint, cold start time, and invocation latency, with external dependencies on crewai.tools and pydantic.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Data class for statistical metrics such as mean, stddev, min, max, and percentiles.

methods.name: calculate_stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics from a list of float data points.

methods.name: benchmark_tool_registration
methods.description: Measures time to create CrewAI tools via subclassing BaseTool.

methods.name: benchmark_tool_decorator
methods.description: Measures time to create CrewAI tools using @tool decorator.

methods.name: benchmark_memory
methods.description: Measures memory footprint of CrewAI tools.

methods.name: benchmark_cold_start
methods.description: Measures time to create a minimal CrewAI tool setup.

methods.name: benchmark_tool_invocation
methods.description: Measures latency of invoking CrewAI tools.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to run all benchmarks and output results.
